summary: No clipping, spills, overlapping text, broken alignment or print-blocking defect observed. One minor artwork identity/shape mismatch between the bottle custody strip and its material comparison image.

issues.description: Evidence 2/4 bottle artwork shows a narrow plain red paper strip wrapped around the cork. Evidence 5 comparison artwork labels a broad, nearly circular embossed heraldic seal as the removed damaged bottle band. The shape and surface design do not visually match, which can confuse readers comparing the evidence objects.
issues.recommendation: Use a comparison photograph depicting the same narrow red foil-backed custody strip seen on the cork, or make the bottle image visibly show the embossed round component as part of its band.
